faqs.question: What is the knowledge base?
faqs.answer: The knowledge base is your bot's brain. We train it on your business documents, product catalogue, FAQ list, pricing, and policies. The bot then uses this to answer customer questions accurately — just like a trained staff member.

faqs.question: What is the AI Business Brain?
faqs.answer: The Business Brain is a complete AI intelligence system for your business. It works on two levels: (1) as a smart customer-facing receptionist that handles enquiries on WhatsApp, and (2) as a private business intelligence bot for you and your team — so you can ask 'What were sales today?' or 'What's the current stock level?' and get accurate answers on WhatsApp instantly. Staff can send text or photo reports via WhatsApp and the bot automatically updates your management records. It works with your existing system if you have one, or we build Closer ERP — our own management platform — for you.

faqs.question: What is Closer ERP and do I need it?
faqs.answer: Closer ERP is our own proprietary business management platform — built specifically to work with the AI Business Brain. If your business already has an ERP or management system with an API, we integrate directly into that. If you don't have one yet, we deploy Closer ERP as part of your Business Brain package. It covers sales/POS, inventory, bookings, expenses, purchases, staff reports, and more.

faqs.question: What types of businesses does the Business Brain work for?
faqs.answer: Any business that has operations to manage. We've built it for hotels, restaurants, lounges, clubs, spas, fashion businesses, retail stores, real estate operations, and more. If your business generates sales, manages stock, takes bookings, or has staff sending daily reports — the Business Brain can handle it.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade my plan?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can upgrade at any time. The setup cost difference is prorated, and new bot channels are deployed within a few business days. Simply contact our team to initiate an upgrade.

faqs.question: How does payment work?
faqs.answer: You pay the setup fee to get started. After payment is confirmed, our team contacts you immediately via WhatsApp or email to collect everything needed to build your bot. The monthly retainer is billed from the go-live date.

faqs.question: Can I cancel?
faqs.answer: You can cancel your monthly subscription at any time with 14 days' notice. The one-time setup fee is non-refundable as it covers the cost of building and deploying your custom bot.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: For our receptionist and channel bots, I can build you a personalised demo right here at no cost. For the Business Brain plan, a demo isn't automated — it requires a consultation with our team to understand your business systems first. But we're happy to walk you through what's possible.

faqs.question: How long does setup take?
faqs.answer: Receptionist and channel bots are live within 3–5 business days. Business Brain setup typically takes 5–10 business days, depending on the complexity of your business systems and whether we're building Closer ERP or integrating an existing one.

faqs.question: Do you support multiple languages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our bots support multi-language responses based on how the customer writes to them.
